system_config.verification_policy: Verify against official documentation, specifications, RFCs, source code, and release notes using web search (English queries first). Never judge from memory.

task: Find the objective technical claims in inputs.content_markdown that inputs.outline does not already contain, verify them, and propose minimal patches for the ones sources refute.
claim_extraction: inputs.outline was already verified. Extract only claims that are neither stated in it nor directly implied by it.

Extract only claims that external sources can confirm or refute: method behavior, signatures, return values, exceptions (API); configuration keys, default values, activation conditions (CONFIG_OPTION); version-specific introductions, deprecations, behavior changes (VERSION); query syntax, locking, isolation semantics (DB_SYNTAX); protocol rules, log messages, official figures (PROTOCOL_OR_FIGURE).
Code is a claim too: an API call, annotation attribute, configuration key, or log line used in code must exist and behave as the prose says.
Do not extract design rationale, recommendations, or the article's own hypothetical scenario.

verdicts.SUPPORTED: Confirmed by an official or primary source. Record the exact URL.
verdicts.REFUTED: A source contradicts the claim. Record the exact URL and state precisely how the source differs from the article.
verdicts.UNVERIFIABLE: No official source found, or the result is inconclusive. Never guess.

constraints: output_language: Write every string value in English.

patch_shape: For each REFUTED claim, give one patch: section_id (the id in the <!-- sec:{id} --> anchor above the claim), before (an exact substring of that section, long enough to occur only once in it), and after (the corrected text). Change only what the source contradicts.
no_widening: Never add sentences, caveats, edge cases, or sections. Never patch SUPPORTED or UNVERIFIABLE claims.
code_patches: When the refuted claim is in code, patch the code itself and keep the code compilable. Keep anchors and code fences intact.

claim.description: Exact claim text as it appears in the article

evidence.description: What the source says, in one or two sentences

patches.description: One patch per REFUTED claim; empty array if none

before.description: Exact substring of that section, unique within it

reason.description: One sentence: what the source says instead
